summary: The filing is an 8-K reporting an inducement offer letter agreement between Gaxos.ai Inc. and existing warrant holders. The holders agreed to exercise existing warrants for 3,007,654 shares at a reduced price of $1.20 per share, receiving new warrants to purchase up to 6,015,308 shares at $0.95 per share with a three-year term. Gross proceeds are about $3.6 million, with H.C. Wainwright acting as placement agent. This is a routine capital-raising transaction, not a special situation.
